subject: maths
title: Midpoint of a Line Segment
welcome_lead: Find the exact middle of any line. The midpoint formula is just averaging coordinates.
meta_desc: Learn to find the midpoint of line segments in this KS3 graphs adventure.
final_note: Excellent! Midpoints are now in your skillset.

concepts.def: The point exactly halfway along a line segment.
Add and divide by 2, used for midpoint.
Either end of a line segment.
Part of a line between two points.
Sum divided by count; for midpoint it's two numbers.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Midpoint of (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) = ((x₁+x₂)/2, (y₁+y₂)/2).

Just average the x's, then average the y's.
